messages:
sara_partners: Heads up — OrangeValley committed 120 GPUs (A100-80GB) in AZ-east via OrangeDock. Partner just flagged a cross-dock hold, estimated delay ~9–12 days. This directly impacts the Dedicated reservation start for OV production (RV-AV-9812, RV-AV-9813). Need options: partial fulfillment, marketplace burst, or credits. Who can triage?

mike_ops: ack. do we have a manifest or any partial ship confirmation? any concrete eta for first container?

jean_sales: FYI customer contract has a hard start date 2026-04-10. They'll escalate legal if we miss. We should prep a mitigation offer now — marketplace burst + credit?

dan_engineering: re-route possibility: other regions have capacity but not A100-80GB exact sku. fallback will change perf/cost. need to know OV tolerance (latency/throughput).

sara_partners: Partner just sent a split plan — they can release 40 GPUs earlier (partial container) and the remainder later. Raw details they provided: 

```
manifest: ORNG-CTNR-2231
sku: A100-80GB
qty: 40
eta: 2026-04-03T14:20:00Z

manifest: ORNG-CTNR-2232
sku: A100-80GB
qty: 80
eta: 2026-04-12T09:00:00Z
tracking: pending customs release for second container
```

They say freight delta for split will be covered by partner, but there may be a small handling fee.

mike_ops: ok tentative plan: 
1) Accept partial 40 as a short-term Dedicated ramp; convert those units from staging pool to OV reserve.
2) Fill remaining 80 using marketplace burst (on-demand) until full containers arrive.
3) Enable aggressive batching/quantization for OV workloads during burst to limit cost.
I'll open a capacity-change ticket and temp runbook changes.

orion-bot: Shipping update: ORNG-CTNR-2231 status: "in transit" — ETA 2026-04-03 14:20 UTC (last scanned at hub-SEA).

sara_partners: @jean_sales can we offer OV a 15% start-delay credit + temporary marketplace capacity for first 30 days while we stabilize? partner will cover freight difference. Need commercial sign-off by EOD otherwise customer pushes for full refund clause. :worried: 

jean_sales: approve 15% credit for start-delay and 30-day marketplace window. Legal wants a short amendment note in writing. Please add exact dates & compensatory period. :+1:

dan_engineering: technical mitigation: we can route OV to mixed-precision variants on smaller GPUs for non-latency-critical jobs. Requires a quick eval (1 day) and a config flip in scheduler. If approved, we can reduce marketplace spend by ~30%.

mike_ops: creating ticket INC-20260401-capacity-split with steps: reserve 40 -> move to OV pool, enable burst sku on marketplace with capped spend, update routing rules, contact oncall for rollout. tagging @oncall in the ticket.

sara_partners: thanks all. I'll confirm with OrangeDock ops and post manifest scans + customs hold details here when available. Will also draft the amendment for legal and loop in Jean. :thumbsup:

mike_ops: leaving note — pls update this thread when tracking #2232 clears customs so we can cancel marketplace burst early.

sara_partners: will do. next update in ~6 hours or earlier if partner provides docs.
